# Integration Checklist: Plugin Source and Payload Bash Eradication

**Purpose**: Validate integration-quality requirements for keeping plugin source behavior, generated Claude/Codex payloads, installed-cache proof, and release gates aligned on one no-shell runtime path.
**Created**: 2026-07-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Domain**: integration

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Source Behavior Ownership

- [x] CHK001 Are all live `speckit-pro/` `.sh` files required to be inventoried before deletion so the integration baseline is deterministic? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Research Decision 2]
- [x] CHK002 Are retained active behaviors required to have Python runner, helper, or gate ownership before their shell scripts are removed? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, Plan Slice 1]
- [x] CHK003 Are delete-only script classifications bounded to inactive or obsolete behavior rather than active helper, runtime, registry, or workflow behavior? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications, Research Decision 3]
- [x] CHK004 Are active registries and outputs required to expose Python operation IDs instead of runnable `.sh` paths after source cleanup? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Data Model Python Operation Ownership Record]
- [x] CHK005 Are Python wrappers around live `.sh` files explicitly prohibited across source cleanup requirements and guard expectations? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK006 Are shell library files under plugin script paths covered by dependent behavior ownership before removal? [Completeness, Research Decision 3, Plan Slice 1]

## Cross-Surface Runtime Contract

- [x] CHK007 Do source guidance requirements cover active skills, Codex skills, agents, Codex agents, hooks, README, install guidance, and plugin script surfaces? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications, Plan Technical Context]
- [x] CHK008 Do generated Claude and Codex payload requirements preserve the same direct Python runner contract as plugin source guidance? [Consistency, Spec FR-006 to FR-007, Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK009 Does installed-cache proof have to be produced from rebuilt payloads instead of mutable real user cache state? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Plan Storage]
- [x] CHK010 Are generated payloads, installed-cache proof, and source roots all included in one zero-Bash guard request rather than independent partial checks? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Data Model Zero-Bash Guard Request]
- [x] CHK011 Are out-of-scope repository-wide Bash surfaces clearly separated from plugin source, generated payload, and installed-cache integration requirements? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Plan Non-goals]
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec preserve XPLAT-008 native UAT as separate release context instead of treating XPLAT-009 cache proof as native platform signoff? [Consistency, Spec FR-012, Research Decision 8]

## Payload And Cache Proof Integration

- [x] CHK013 Is payload rebuild evidence required to be source-derived through the runner payload-completeness operation rather than hand-edited `dist/**` output? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Research Decision 6]
- [x] CHK014 Are payload rebuild records required to include source roots, output roots, transform records, file-tree hashes, and missing/extra/mismatch/path-leak results? [Measurability, Plan Slice 2, Data Model Payload Rebuild Record]
- [x] CHK015 Are both Claude and Codex generated payload roots required to report zero `.sh` files and zero unallowlisted active Bash or `jq` guidance? [Measurability, Spec SC-003, Quickstart Section 2]
- [x] CHK016 Is installed-cache proof required per surface with product, installed root, source payload root/hash, file inventory, source-derived state, and allowlist exclusion state? [Completeness, Spec Clarifications, Data Model Installed Cache Proof Record]
- [x] CHK017 Is mutable real user cache evidence excluded from satisfying required release-readiness proof while still allowing supplemental context? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications, Research Decision 7]
- [x] CHK018 Are source-to-dist drift and dist-to-cache drift both detectable through required evidence rather than only through file-count checks? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Plan Slice 2]

## Release Gate Alignment

- [x] CHK019 Is the zero-Bash guard result shaped as a runner envelope with blocking counts, classified counts, bounded findings, scan roots, allowlist entries, and diagnostics? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications, Data Model Zero-Bash Guard Result]
- [x] CHK020 Does release readiness block on missing scan roots, missing installed-cache proof, blocking findings, or allowlist evidence being counted as release-ready proof? [Coverage, Spec Clarifications, Quickstart Section 4]
- [x] CHK021 Are historical or archived Bash references allowed only through documented allowlist entries that are excluded from release readiness? [Consistency, Spec FR-009, Research Decision 5]
- [x] CHK022 Are active instruction findings required to classify Bash, `.sh`, `jq`, shell interpolation, Git Bash, WSL, PowerShell-specific command language, and Unix-only assumptions across all in-scope surfaces? [Coverage, Spec FR-005, Data Model Active Instruction Finding]
- [x] CHK023 Are seeded regressions required to fail when Bash scripts or active shell-oriented guidance are reintroduced into source, generated payloads, or installed-cache proof? [Measurability, Spec FR-010, Spec SC-005]
- [x] CHK024 Does the review packet requirement map integration-facing requirements and success criteria to changed files and deterministic evidence? [Traceability, Spec FR-011, Plan PR review packet source]

- Focus areas selected: active plugin-source Bash behavior ownership, source/generated/cache contract alignment, source-derived payload rebuild proof, installed-cache proof, release-readiness gate integration, and drift between `speckit-pro/**`, `dist/**`, and installed-cache proof after `.sh` removal.
- Depth level: Standard integration requirements quality review.
